```yaml
name: Close Old Bot Discussions

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day

jobs:
  create-issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy
      
      - name: Create Issue
        id: create-issue
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/create-issue/main.go --title "New Issue" --body "This is a new issue"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  link-sub-issue:
    needs: create-issue
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod tidy
      
      - name: Link Sub Issue
        run: |
          go run ./cmd/link-sub-issue/main.go --parent-issue-id ${{ needs.create-issue.outputs.issue_number }} --sub-issue-id "12345"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

This workflow includes two jobs: `create-issue` and `link-sub-issue`. The `create-issue` job creates a new issue using the `go run` command and sets the output `issue_number`. The `link-sub-issue` job depends on the `create-issue` job and links a sub-issue to the newly created parent issue using the `go run` command. Both jobs use the `GITHUB_TOKEN` secret to authenticate with the GitHub API.
